title: About Face: The Essentials of Interaction Design
extraction_notes: Identity verified from title/copyright pages. Title page additionally credits Jason Csizmadi and Doug LeMoine as contributors.

All PDF ranges inclusive and one-based. For Arabic chapter pages, printed page equals PDF page minus30. Blank final chapter pages have null printed_end; last numbered content page is recorded in notes.

Text extracted with pypdf. Extraction is not itself a reading claim: chapter1–17 prose/captions were displayed and studied in bounded batches by core source reviewer; chapter18–21 by a separate source agent, then integrated from original notes and coverage. Truncated passages were reread.

All21 substantive chapter bodies studied. No text/gallery pages excluded. Selected18 figure pages rendered and visually inspected; other figures remain visually unverified despite caption study. PDF images and raw text remain outside repository.

PDF1–16 identity/contents/credits and27–29 introduction assessed, but full front-matter reading is not claimed. Part dividers, AppendixA685–690, bibliography691–696 and index697–722 are not included in full chapter-body study.
PartII dividerPDF195 reverses chapter10/11 names; actual chapter headings and contents establish the ledger titles.

Historical examples and specialized desktop,3D,embedded,kiosk,TV,automotive/audio material were read and assessed. Dated specifications, predictions, source errors and rhetorical universals are excluded from current normative recommendations, not recorded as unread pages.

Known source issues: PDF447 square-root-of-two ratio typo and old4:3 display assumption; PDF457 correlation/causation conflation; PDF483 paste-shortcut typo; historical contrast/font/flash/timing advice not current accessibility specifications. Current platform sources required for normative rules.

chapters.title: A Design Process for Digital Products
chapters.notes: Goals, represented models and design process studied; developer stereotypes and guaranteed-outcome rhetoric not adopted.

chapters.title: Understanding the Problem: Design Research
chapters.notes: Research methods, recruiting, interviewing and method tradeoffs studied; fixed sample counts and broad method dismissals not universal rules. Final PDF page 90 is blank; last numbered content page is printed 59.

chapters.title: Modeling Users: Personas and Goals
chapters.notes: All persona construction and supporting-model material read, including provisional personas. No fabricated participant quotes or inferred demographic stereotypes. Final PDF page 130 is blank; last numbered content page is printed 99.

chapters.title: Setting the Vision: Scenarios and Design Requirements
chapters.notes: Context, key-path and validation scenarios and requirements derivation studied. Aspirational ideation is not authorization to automate consequential acts. Final PDF page 148 is blank; last numbered content page is printed 117.

chapters.title: Designing the Product: Framework and Refinement
chapters.notes: All framework, visual/industrial/service design, refinement and validation material studied. Early user feedback and technical collaboration retained. Final PDF page 174 is blank; last numbered content page is printed 143.

chapters.title: Creative Teamwork
chapters.notes: All design teamwork, roles, organizational and hiring discussion read. Retained collaborative iteration; PDF188 explicitly revises all-design-before-code belief. Agent workflows are adaptations.

chapters.title: A Basis for Good Product Behavior
chapters.notes: Values, principles and patterns read. Context-specific pattern reasoning retained; historical drawer praise not current prescription.

chapters.title: Digital Etiquette
chapters.notes: All considerate product and social-product discussion read. Retained privacy, preservation and helpful defaults; unrestricted memory/background activity and numerical social claims not adopted.

chapters.title: Platform and Posture
chapters.notes: All desktop, web, mobile and other-device posture material read. Old device limitations, fullscreen bias and universally transient-mobile assumptions excluded from recommendations. Final PDF page 266 is blank; last numbered content page is printed 235.

chapters.title: Optimizing for Intermediates
chapters.notes: All expertise and progressive-disclosure material read; source qualifications considered. No assumed universal expertise distribution or click-count budget. Final PDF page 278 is blank; last numbered content page is printed 247.

chapters.title: Orchestration and Flow
chapters.notes: All orchestration, directness, feedback, defaults, protection, responsiveness and motion discussion read. Historical timing suggestions contextual, rare consequential needs retained. Final PDF page 300 is blank; last numbered content page is printed 269.

chapters.title: Reducing Work and Eliminating Excise
chapters.notes: All work/excise, navigation, mapping, hierarchy and mechanical-metaphor discussion and captions read. No blanket hierarchy/modal bans or pane counts. Historical calendar examples assessed, not skipped. Final PDF page 328 is blank; last numbered content page is printed 297.

chapters.title: Metaphors, Idioms, and Affordances
chapters.notes: All conceptual paradigms, idiom vocabulary, affordance terminology, direct manipulation and hinting read. Learn-once claims and flat/skeuomorphic judgments not universal. Perceived cues distinguished from actual capabilities. Final PDF page 354 is blank; last numbered content page is printed 323.

chapters.title: Rethinking Data Entry, Storage, and Retrieval
chapters.notes: All entry, storage, retrieval and query material read. PDF362 reread after tiny output gap. Retained tolerant input, explicit corrections, persistence and attribute retrieval. Reject unrestricted data acceptance, silent guesses and historical database/NLP limitations. Final PDF page 386 is blank; last numbered content page is printed 355.

chapters.title: Preventing Errors and Informing Decisions
chapters.notes: All modeless visual/audible feedback, undo variants, histories, versions and comparison material read. Irreversible effects and undo dependencies considered. Silence not sole error cue; external transaction limits preserved. Final PDF page 408 is blank; last numbered content page is printed 377.

chapters.title: Designing for Different Needs
chapters.notes: All command learning, help, templates, wizards, customization, localization and accessibility material read. Historical numeric prescriptions and separate accessibility mode as default not adopted. Final PDF page 434 is blank; last numbered content page is printed 403.

chapters.title: Integrating Visual Design
chapters.notes: All visual attributes, typography, hierarchy, layout, icons, feedback, information design, standards and design language read. Geometry typo, causality conflation and old typography/contrast specifications excluded from recommendations.

chapters.title: Designing for the Desktop
chapters.notes: All substantive text and example captions read. Direct manipulation, selection, task-centered panes, learnability and expertise retained; historical OS/pointer implementations and detailed3D techniques not imposed universally. Studied by delegated interaction-patterns source agent; integrated from its original chapter notes and exact coverage ledger.

chapters.title: Designing for Mobile and Other Devices
chapters.notes: All substantive text and historical captions read, including phone/tablet patterns, navigation, gestures, search, inter-app integration and other-device domains. Retained context, state, learnability and flow principles; old device specifications, transient-only assumptions, mandatory wrapping, long-press ban and desktop-satellite framing not adopted. Studied by delegated interaction-patterns source agent; integrated from its original chapter notes and exact coverage ledger.

chapters.title: Designing for the Web
chapters.notes: All chapter text and historical captions read, plus trailing blank page. Retained web wayfinding, search refinement, scrolling tradeoffs and responsive context. Old framework/technology commentary, blanket top-nav/sticky-header preferences and fixed breakpoints not current requirements. Studied by delegated interaction-patterns source agent; integrated from its original chapter notes and exact coverage ledger. Final PDF page is blank; last numbered content page is printed 587.

chapters.title: Design Details: Controls and Dialogs
chapters.notes: All chapter text and captions read through final printed654. Retained semantic control choice, scope/state, context-appropriate inputs, explicit dialog commit semantics, useful progress and recovery. Universal no-errors/no-confirmations rhetoric, mandatory blocking alerts, silent numeric substitution and old exact widget prescriptions not adopted. Studied by delegated interaction-patterns source agent; integrated from its original chapter notes and exact coverage ledger.
